description: Answers several questions about the conversation in one Jev call and writes the answers to the temporary state

llm_provider_id.description: The TypeSafe Jev provider this node calls.
llm_provider_id.title: Model

llm_provider_model_id.description: The model to call, e.g. gpt-4o. Must belong to the same provider type as `llm_provider_id` -- an OpenAI provider cannot run an Anthropic model.
llm_provider_model_id.title: Llm Provider Model Id

llm_model_parameters.description: Generation settings passed to the model, such as `temperature`. Which keys are accepted depends on the model; leave empty to use its defaults.
llm_model_parameters.title: Llm Model Parameters

history_type.title: PipelineChatHistoryTypes
history_type.description: Which past messages to put in the prompt. `none` sends only the current input; `node` remembers just this node's own turns; `named` shares one history between every node set to the same `history_name`; `global` uses the participant's whole conversation.

history_name.description: The shared history to read and write. Only used when `history_type` is `named`.
history_name.title: History Name

history_mode.title: PipelineChatHistoryModes
history_mode.description: How to shrink history that outgrows its limit: `summarize` replaces old messages with a summary, `truncate_tokens` drops them to fit `user_max_token_limit`, and `max_history_length` keeps only the most recent `max_history_length` messages.

user_max_token_limit.description: Maximum number of tokens before messages are summarized or truncated.
user_max_token_limit.title: Token Limit

max_history_length.description: Chat history will only keep the most recent messages up to this limit.
max_history_length.title: Max History Length

name.description: Identifies the node within its pipeline. Another node reaches this one's result through `temp_state.outputs.<name>`, so renaming it breaks any template that does.
name.title: Node Name

decisions.description: The questions to answer, all in one call. Each answer is written to the temporary state under its decision's `key`, and the node passes its input on unchanged.

key.description: The temporary state key the answer is written to. Choice and score decisions also write their confidence to `<key>_confidence`.
key.title: Key

type.description: `choice` writes the chosen option's name, `score` writes a number from 0 to the highest level, and `noul` writes the probability, from 0 to 1, that the statement in `instructions` is true.
type.title: Type

instructions.description: The question to answer. For a `noul` decision, the statement to judge.
instructions.title: Instructions

options.description: Choice only. The options to choose between, 1 to 255.

name.description: The value written to the temporary state when this option is chosen.
name.title: Name

options.title: Options

levels.description: Score only. The rubric, one description per level from lowest (0) to highest, 1 to 10 levels.
levels.title: Levels

true_description.description: Noul only. What a true statement means. Optional.
true_description.title: True Description

false_description.description: Noul only. What a false statement means. Optional.
false_description.title: False Description

threshold.description: Choice and score only. When the confidence is below this, null is written instead of the answer, so a Static Router reading the key takes its default route. Leave empty to always write the answer.
threshold.title: Threshold

decisions.title: Decisions

title: DecisionNode
ui:label: Decision Node
